svg.title: Beltline machine catalogue
svg.desc: One of each machine kind in the Beltline kit, joined by belts, with a short trace that writes cells and moves pointers.
svg.text: Every kit machine with sample values. Illustrative, not a recording.

g.text: 1/5 rack: a write lands in a cell, the len pointer moves
2/5 drum: the tail arm turns one slot
3/5 selector: the needle turns to the new state
4/5 plate: pixels are painted in place
5/5 turnstile: the gate turns when the lock is taken
